concept: Reentrancy: external calls can reenter before state is finalized, so state must be updated before the call.
scene: Dark navy background with a simple diagram: a contract box handing control to a second box via an arrow, with a looping amber arrow returning to the first box before a storage cell is cleared. Clean, calm, technical layout with generous space for the overlay text.
overlay_text: State updates after untrusted calls allow repeated execution
alt_text: Diagram of one contract calling another, with an arrow looping back to the first contract before its stored balance is cleared, illustrating reentrancy.
